messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Automated alert: heartbeat-aggregator detected sustained 5xx error-rate spike for /v1/generate across edge-proxies in eu-west1. PD incident: https://pd.example/INC12345 — paging oncall.
PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> INC12345, escalation policy 'inference-sre'.
Leo (oncall): acked. I'll take initial lead. pinging SREs, holding page.
Anna (SRE): on my way, looking at metrics now. Any customer reports yet? @Maya
Maya (Product Ops): no support tickets surfaced yet, but we just got one alerting customer healthcheck in EU. I'll monitor support queue.
Leo (oncall): quick summary from IncidentBot shows 5xx rate went from ~0.2% to 12% starting ~5m ago. Spike correlates with a config push to rate-limiter service ~6m ago.
Jordan (Eng Runtime): that config push was a change to global token-bucket defaults (burst=0 -> burst=5) rolled to eu-west1 at 03:14 UTC. Could be related. I can pull the deploy log.
Anna (SRE): grabbing ingress proxy logs for a sample UUID. Running:
```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=edge-proxy -c proxy --tail=200 | rg "500|502|503" | head -n 40
```
Anna (SRE): output shows a lot of upstream connection resets and upstream timeout errors, pattern: `http downstream error: upstream reset by peer` and lots of `rate_limiter: reject` entries interspersed.
Leo (oncall): ok that suggests the rate-limiter started rejecting bursts which caused retries and congestion leading to upstream failures. Any saturated pods / CPU spikes?
Anna (SRE): metrics:
```
- edge-proxy cpu p95: 62% -> 88% across eu-west1
- rate-limiter errors: 0.1/s -> 45/s
- backend kv cache latency: stable ~12ms
```
Anna (SRE): looks like the rate-limiter itself is erroring (invalid config path), not just rejecting traffic. I see `panic: invalid token bucket config` in one pod.
Jordan (Eng Runtime): oh — the config schema changed upstream and our rollout included an older agent that can't parse `burst: auto`. Rolling back config should be fastest mitigation. Can we patch the config to previous stable on eu-west1?
Leo (oncall): do it. Jordan, can you initiate rollback? If not, we'll remove the new config from configmap.
Jordan (Eng Runtime): starting rollback now — applying stable config map `rl-config:stable` to eu-west1 clusters.
Ops Bot: applying configmap patch to inference-eu-west1: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap rl-config --patch '{"data":{"burst":"5"}}'`
Jordan (Eng Runtime): patch applied. Restarting rate-limiter pods to pick up config.
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/rate-limiter -l region=eu-west1
```
Anna (SRE): pods becoming ready. Watching error-rate dashboard.
Leo (oncall): dropping PD urgency to low, but keeping incident open until 15m of stable 5xx baseline.
Maya (Product Ops): notifying affected customers proactively: draft msg to EU accounts: "We observed elevated error rates on inference endpoints in EU; mitigation in progress..." Want approval to send now?
Leo (oncall): go ahead with transparency. Mention no data loss and rollback in progress.
Maya (Product Ops): sent to support and CS; will post status update in status.redwood.com once we confirm recovery.
Anna (SRE): 5xx rate trending down: now 2.3% -> 0.4% over 6 minutes. Edge cpu normalizing.
Leo (oncall): good. I'll leave a remediation TODO: add config schema validation to CI for the rate-limiter config and gate rollouts by agent version.
Jordan (Eng Runtime): noted. I'll open a PR to add strict schema validation and a canary guard for configmap changes.
Anna (SRE): temporary mitigation checklist completed: rollback + pod restart. Long-term: add schema validation + better deploy gating. Also add an automated runbook step to auto-rollback on parse errors.
Leo (oncall): handing off to Anna for post-incident writeup. I'll add a short blameless summary to PD.
Anna (SRE): will draft postmortem with timeline, customer impact (estimated ~3% of EU requests affected during window), root cause (schema incompatibility + unguarded config rollout), and remediation actions.
Maya (Product Ops): support notified customers and will coordinate any follow-up comms. Marking severity: P2 given limited customer impact and fast rollback.
IncidentBot: Incident INC12345 status updated -> mitigated (partial).
Leo (oncall): thanks team. Leaving a reminder: follow-up review tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Closing active paging channel unless new alerts surface. :thumbsup:
Anna (SRE): logging notes and links to logs/metrics in the postmortem draft. Will attach config diffs and the deploy window.
Jordan (Eng Runtime): PR for schema validation draft opened: https://git.example/r/redwood/rl-config/pulls/42
Maya (Product Ops): recording timeline in support ticket and queued follow-up post to status page after final confirmation.
Ops Bot: monitoring heartbeat-aggregator at increased sensitivity for next 2 hours.
Leo (oncall): final check: any residual customer impact? Maya?
Maya (Product Ops): no new complaints. closing loop from support POV.
Leo (oncall): closing the thread — thanks all.
